question: Can sample-pair chain reversal improve learned conditional dynamics without inference projection or additional flow evaluations?
transform: Reverse lattice index of initial and target together; no time reversal, spin inversion or theta change.
unit: Training seed; initial-family and temperature comparisons remain dependent diagnostic conditions, not independent training replicates.
evaluation: All 12 development conditions for all three seeds; saved whole paths; paired latent seeds against coverage control. Report mean, variance, spatial and temporal associations and selected joint-path statistics; retain unfavorable conditions.
limitations: Reuse of historical computational controls requires matching code, checkpoint and data hashes; not a randomized concurrent hardware timing study. Three seeds are a bounded diagnostic, not a powered certification. Augmentation does not enforce exact learned reflection equivariance. This plan does not establish long-time or large-system validity.
preflight: Pair mapping, involution, no input mutation, independent RNG reproducibility and physical reference chain reversal must pass before wiring and submission.
